contents:
[package]
name = "freemkv-engine"
version = "1.7.6"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT"
description = "freemkv rip engine — disc→MKV orchestration over libfreemkv, shared by every front-end (CLI, autorip, desktop UI)"
repository = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-engine"
keywords = ["bluray", "uhd", "dvd", "ripper", "backup"]
categories = ["multimedia"]
exclude = ["CLAUDE.md"]
publish = false

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
libfreemkv = "1.7"
freemkv-keysources = "1.7"
tracing = "0.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.isolang]
version = "2"
features = ["lowercase_names"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

[patch.crates-io.libfreemkv]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/libfreemkv"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[patch.crates-io.freemkv-keysources]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-keysources"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "allow"

[package]
name = "freemkv-i18n"
version = "1.7.6"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT"
description = "i18n string loader for the freemkv toolchain (bundled + on-disk locales)"
repository = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-i18n"
keywords = ["i18n", "localization", "freemkv"]
categories = ["internationalization"]

[lib]
name = "freemkv_i18n"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "allow"

[package]
name = "freemkv-keysources"
version = "1.7.6"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT"
description = "Pluggable AACS key sources (keydb, online key service) for libfreemkv. Each source looks a disc up and hands libfreemkv its terminal Unit Keys via get_unit_keys; the library does all derivation."
repository = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-keysources"
keywords = ["aacs", "blu-ray", "uhd", "decryption", "keydb"]
categories = ["multimedia"]
publish = false

[dependencies]
libfreemkv = "1.7"
serde_json = "1"
base64 = "0.23"
flate2 = "1"
tracing = "0.1"

[dependencies.ureq]
version = "3"
features = ["json"]

[dependencies.zip]
version = "8"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

[patch.crates-io.libfreemkv]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/libfreemkv"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "allow"

[package]
name = "freemkv-unlock"
version = "1.7.6"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT"
description = "Unlock layer for the freemkv toolchain: the Unlocker contract + self-contained firmware/AACS/CSS unlocker modules. libfreemkv depends on this and dispatches via all_unlockers()."
repository = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-unlock"
publish = false

[features]
emulation = []

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
base64 = "0.23"
tracing = "0.1"
num-bigint = "0.5"
num-traits = "0.2"
sha1 = "0.11"
sha2 = "0.11"
aes = "0.9"
rand = "0.10"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "allow"

[package]
name = "libfreemkv"
version = "1.7.6"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "MIT"
description = "Open source raw disc access library for optical drives"
repository = "https://github.com/freemkv/libfreemkv"
keywords = ["bluray", "uhd", "optical", "scsi", "disc"]
categories = ["hardware-support", "multimedia"]
exclude = ["CLAUDE.md"]
publish = false

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1

[features]
default = ["rip", "scsi"]
scsi = ["dep:tracing"]
rip = ["scsi", "dep:serde", "dep:serde_json", "dep:sha1", "dep:aes", "dep:freemkv-unlock", "dep:zip", "dep:base64", "dep:roxmltree", "dep:crossbeam-channel", "dep:rayon", "dep:memchr"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.sha1]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dependencies.aes]
version = "0.9"
optional = true

[dependencies.freemkv-unlock]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-unlock"
tag = "v1.7.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.zip]
version = "8"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]
optional = true

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.23"
optional = true

[dependencies.roxmltree]
version = "0.20"
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.crossbeam-channel]
version = "0.5"
optional = true

[dependencies.rayon]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.memchr]
version = "2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target."cfg(loom)".dev-dependencies]
loom = "0.7"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[[bench]]
name = "sgio_read"
harness = false

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(loom)"]

[lints.clippy]
uninlined_format_args = "allow"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-engine"]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-engine"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[source."https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-i18n"]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-i18n"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[source."https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-keysources"]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-keysources"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[source."https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-unlock"]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/freemkv-unlock"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.7.6"

[source."https://github.com/freemkv/libfreemkv"]
git = "https://github.com/freemkv/libfreemkv"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.7.6"
